acceptance_rule: All governance, complete dependencies/registry, materiality proof, adversarial and positive controls, frozen future policy, historical preservation, locked Final Test/no modeling/network, all historical/new tests, deterministic repeats and immutable upstream inputs; approval determined only from evidence

approval_decision_rules.APPROVED_CANONICAL_VINTAGE: All critical governance/reproducibility/immutability gates pass, no known unresolved cross-vintage discrepancies remain
approval_decision_rules.APPROVED_WITH_DOCUMENTED_NONMATERIAL_CRO: All critical governance gates pass, coherent immutable candidate, complete registry, every unresolved known discrepancy programmatically proven provenance-material but current-model-semantic-nonmaterial, all mutation/positive controls pass, future policy and use restrictions frozen; legacy root remains unresolved
approval_decision_rules.NOT_APPROVED_FOR_DOWNSTREAM_RESEARCH: Any critical governance/source/hash/internal/calendar/corporate-action/PIT/target/reproducibility failure, semantic-material discrepancy, unknown materiality, incomplete registry, unresolved dependency proof or broken positive controls

approval_scope.direction: Multi-year walk-forward Relative Market baseline/reference research; OLS, inherited Ridge(alpha=1), zero_return, historical_mean; primary forward_return_5d

governance_axis_definition: Frozen source identity/hash/query boundaries, normalized coherence, calendar/critical OHLC, existing corporate-action/PIT/target audits, reproducibility and upstream preservation must pass; do not reuse Stage13 strict legacy-overlap failure as automatic prospective failure
known_discrepancy_registration_rule: Read original Stage13 unexpected overlap differences; deduplicate independent ticker/date/field/value observations and preserve all five manifestations; cannot drop known Volume mismatch
legacy_immutability_rule: Stage1–12 remain immutable historical research records; if approved their future role is HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_RECORD_ONLY
materiality_axis_definition: Classify every independent known discrepancy using code-derived field dependencies, frozen authoritative manifests and isolated mutation/positive controls; unknown dependency evidence fails closed

materiality_decision_rules.PROVENANCE_MATERIAL_MODEL_SEMANTIC_NONMA: Complete code/manifest evidence plus legal-value mutation tests prove no current X/Y/PIT numerical/provenance/eligibility dependency; discrepancy remains provenance-material
materiality_decision_rules.RESEARCH_SEMANTIC_MATERIAL: Known field change affects registered X/Y/PIT construction or provenance/eligibility, via direct/indirect dependency or observed mutation differences
materiality_decision_rules.UNKNOWN_MATERIALITY: Any incomplete dependency, unsupported code change, inconclusive mutation/positive control or unverified required relation

metadata_gap_policy: Unknown acquisition-time retrieval timestamp/library version/endpoint remain null; documented limitation may be accepted only with frozen original payloads, hash identity, query range, exact normalization preservation, reproducibility and critical internal audits; no fabricated metadata or absolute-truth claim

mutation_rules.Final_Test: Never predictive performance; any numeric target audit excludes locked Final Test target cells
mutation_rules.general_dates: Deterministic observed sessions spanning pre-sample and multiple research years, including split contexts and pre-Final-Test 2026; at least four representative historical dates
general_mutations: all Volume values multiplied by 10 plus 123
mutation_rules.outputs_checked: 9 market,3 relative SMA,all registered fundamental feature/provenance states,1d/5d/20d targets and row/date eligibility
mutation_rules.positive_controls: Isolated valid OHLC changes must change their registered feature/target dependents; actual source pipeline must execute

no_cell_patching_rule: Never splice legacy and Stage13 cells or edit/drop primary date/Volume; use one coherent frozen vintage
reproducibility: At least two consecutive offline formal runs on frozen inputs; all deterministic CSV/JSON byte-identical; no current timestamp in formal output; execution log explicitly excluded

research_dependency_rules.PIT_fundamentals: All registered fundamental features and provenance/activation state fields; exclude carried raw market fields from fundamental-state equality
research_dependency_rules.global_preprocessing_dependencies: Audit validity/date/row-selection gates as well as numeric formulas; a legal Volume count change must not change registered values or row eligibility
research_dependency_rules.symbolic_dependency_evidence: Parse existing feature/relative/target/integration/preprocessing source; record actual transformations and source/function/hash references; do not replace formulas with prompt examples

stage13_immutability_rule: Stage13 candidate/raw/formal outputs/blocked report,Stage13.1 outputs/policy/report,Recovery outputs/report stay byte-identical; no regeneration of old artifacts
